neighbours.label: supernatural / mystical vocabulary (' mystical', ' beings', ' powers', ' spirits', ' portal')
fire: The old legend speaks of mystical forests where no one returns.
Many cultures believe that supernatural beings guard the mountains.
The wizard used his magic powers to open the gate.
She stepped through the glowing portal into another world.
The shaman claimed to talk with spirits every night.
The temple was built to honor divine beings from the sky.
There was something mystical about the quiet lake at dawn.
In the story, the hero gains strange powers after the storm.
quiet: The old legend speaks of dark forests where no one returns.
Many cultures believe that armed soldiers guard the mountains.
The wizard used his old key to open the gate.
She stepped through the wooden door into another room.
The shaman claimed to talk with farmers every night.
The temple was built to honor rich merchants from the coast.
There was something peaceful about the quiet lake at dawn.
In the story, the hero gains new friends after the storm.
